questions.question: 1. What is the maximum number of comparisons in one iteration for an array of size N?

explanations.a: Incorrect. The inner loop checks all remaining elements, not just half.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The number of comparisons in one iteration does not exceed N.
explanations.c: Correct. In the first iteration, we compare N-1 elements, which is approximately N comparisons.
explanations.d: Incorrect. N^2 is the total number of comparisons for the entire algorithm, not one iteration.

questions.question: 2. If an array is [6,1,9,10], which element will be sorted first by selection sort?

explanations.a: Incorrect. 9 is not the minimum element in the array.
explanations.b: Incorrect. 10 is not the minimum element in the array.
explanations.c: Correct. Selection sort finds the minimum element (1) first and places it in the first position.
explanations.d: Incorrect. 6 is the current first element but not the minimum.
